[win/mac/linux] DoomRL - the roguelike based on Doom

Yes, it's for real. No, it's not a joke. Well... it was probably a joke at first, but at this point it's a totally legit honest-to-god roguelike with pretty unique mechanics.

As you might imagine, it's heavily based around ranged combat. This is unusual for a roguelike. Using guns, which are also unusual. Pretty much everything you'd expect from Doom is there, from Cacodemons to BFGs, but there's a good deal of extra stuff to flesh it out a bit, mostly in the form of variations on the familiar Doom weapons and equipment.

Three classes, marine, scout, and engineer, with skill trees and unique abilities. A crafting system, with special weapons and armors. Special levels with extra challenges, some of which are really difficult... It sort of beggars belief that someone would put so much work into something which sounds like a joke. This is a full-bodied game though and absolutely worth your time.
